content.text: The build fails in `samples/synchronization/src/main.c` with multiple errors about undeclared kernel symbols (`K_FOREVER`, `K_SEM_DEFINE`, `K_THREAD_DEFINE`, `k_tid_t`, etc.). This is a missing `<zephyr/kernel.h>` include. Let me examine the source file.

The issue is clear. Line 10 only includes `<zephyr/sys/printk.h>`, but the file uses kernel primitives (`k_sem_take`, `K_FOREVER`, `K_SEM_DEFINE`, `K_THREAD_DEFINE`, `k_tid_t`, `k_thread_create`, etc.) that require `<zephyr/kernel.h>`. Adding that include will resolve all the errors.

content.content: The file /root/zephyrproject/zephyr/samples/synchronization/src/main.c has been updated successfully.

content.text: Now let me verify the fix by rebuilding.
